headline: Pennsylvania would limit AI data use, allow lawsuits
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Pennsylvania would limit how companies may use a person's data to create artificial intelligence simulations, and would let that person sue over violations. Not passed. It cites the fear that AI is taking people's personal data.

11 measures in six jurisdictions cite the fear that AI makes scams easier to run.

2,250 measures tracked. 757 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
